tails.name: Cotton Tail
tails.description: A fluffy white cotton tail. The most basic tail cosmetic — everyone starts here.

tails.name: Squirrel Tail
tails.description: A bushy squirrel tail. Slightly more detailed than the Cotton Tail but still very common.

tails.name: Fox Tail
tails.description: A sleek orange fox tail with a white tip. A nice step up in visual quality.

tails.name: Bunny Tail
tails.description: A round, puffy bunny tail. Cute and bouncy-looking.

tails.name: Wolf Tail
tails.description: A thick gray wolf tail. Fierce-looking and well-animated.

tails.name: Tiger Tail
tails.description: A striped tiger tail with vibrant orange and black pattern. One of the best-looking rare tails.

tails.name: Dragon Tail
tails.description: A scaled green dragon tail with spikes. Intimidating and highly sought after.

tails.name: Phoenix Tail
tails.description: A fiery phoenix tail with animated flame effects. Glows in-game and looks spectacular.

tails.name: Galaxy Tail
tails.description: A cosmic tail with swirling galaxy pattern. Animated stars and nebula effects. The rarest tail from the Tails Case.

tails.name: Void Dominus Tail
tails.description: The ultimate tail cosmetic. Dark void energy with pulsing purple effects. Exclusive to the Void Crate and the most prestigious tail in the game.

tails.name: Nebula Tail
tails.description: A beautiful nebula-themed tail with swirling purple and blue colors. Decent drop rate from the Void Crate.
